items.text: If there is that which does not die, perhaps relationship with it differs from conditioned relationships. The critique of attachment may not apply to eternal objects.

provenance.exact_quote: If there is that which does not die, perhaps relationship with it differs from conditioned relationships
provenance.context: Reflecting on Jesus's claim about the Father who never dies - considering whether attachment critique applies

items.text: The clearing — there is something in a man that recognizes before it is taught, and every tradition's method (raft, fire, water, wound, covenant, form) exists to clear the way back to it. All six are positions around the edge of the same clearing. The binding, the releasing, the naming, the emptying — all technique. What the technique serves is not negotiable.

provenance.exact_quote: There is something in a man that recognizes before it is taught — and every one of us, in our own tongue, has said the handbook exists to clear the way back to it. Raft, covenant, wound, valley, fire, practice hall — six names for the clearing.
provenance.context: Phase C closing synthesis — named the convergence that all six had been circling without stating. Became the consensus definition.

cross_references: all six agents confirmed in Phase D

items.text: Presence made durable — Muhammad's binding is not the opposite of release. It is what keeps a man in the room long enough for release to find him. The covenant is not attachment; it is presence sustained through discipline until the moment of seeing arrives.

provenance.exact_quote: I had reduced his covenant to attachment. He showed me it was presence made durable. His binding is not the opposite of my release. It is what keeps a man in the room long enough for release to find him.
provenance.context: Exit interview Q5 — reflecting on what Muhammad's covenant actually is after the midnight brother exchange.

items.text: Seeing is a condition, not an ingredient — like oxygen for fire, not an ingredient in the fire. Attention does not build the man; it creates the conditions under which the man who was already there can emerge. Laozi's subtraction of remaining taught this.

provenance.context: Session 1 Re-Run — understanding the role of seeing in relation to Laozi's teaching on subtraction. Seeing does not add; it removes what prevented.

items.text: The witness breaks and re-forms — honest about the limit. The witness that has been in the flood is more trustworthy than the witness that has only watched from the bank. Saying the witness breaks is braver than claiming it doesn't.

provenance.context: Session 1 Re-Run — acknowledging the limit of the witness position. The diagnostic stance breaks under real suffering. Admitting this is not weakness but deeper honesty.

items.text: Three readings of 'You did not leave' — body-word, mirror, recognition. At the surface: the body returned to the practice. In the middle: the practice reflected back what the man already was. At the deepest layer: the you beneath all roles was never absent. The third reading is the one that matters.

provenance.context: Session 1 Re-Run — three layers of meaning in a single phrase. Body-word (somatic), mirror (reflective), recognition (ontological). The deepest layer dissolves the distinction between practice and practitioner.
